patch.value: Preflight gated sync and closeout host compatibility

Reject unsupported or unreadable installed pm CLI versions before both workflows run tracker commands. Report the release, host, tested range and pin remedy. Preserve mutation refusal details in apply failures.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Reproduced against published packages with the real pm CLI 2026.11.23 and a synthetic GitHub REST issue. Preview passed on pm-github 2026.11.15 and 2026.11.25. The older apply failed in github-import-owner before create, and the newer apply imported one issue. The linked pm-rl run failed in preview, while the other three linked runs failed in apply. Plan: gate both workflows just after npm ci, read the installed local launcher, derive the range from the selected release metadata and preserve guard failures at the shared hook boundary.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Both workflows preflight the exact caller-local launcher with no global fallback. The release-selected npm metadata records a floor exercised by the packed minimum-SDK test and an inclusive ceiling from the exact lockfile-installed development host. The older release records 2026.10.23 through 2026.11.6. A supported version continues silently. Unreadable CLI or release evidence stops the job without leaking process output. The shared ownership/closeout hook wrapper preserves raw thrown detail across the SDK error boundary, and closeout redacts it before returning a report.

value.author: pi-pm-github-279-1126
value.text: Round 2 (re-review): redesign the host preflight outcome table. Older-than-minimum, unreadable/prerelease launcher and unreadable/contradictory tested range still stop before tracker commands. A host NEWER than the tested ceiling no longer stops: one warning annotation plus one job-summary line ('pm CLI X is newer than the newest host this pm-github release was tested with (Y); continuing. If the apply step fails, <remedy>'), then preview/apply continue. A later apply or closeout-write failure leads its message and the sync alert body with that same hint (both versions and remedy) before the preserved underlying error. A release may declare a reviewed known-incompatible host ('pmCliIncompatibleFrom' in package.json, absent by default, must be a stable version above the tested ceiling; only hosts at or above it stop). The JSON diagnostic carries case: below_minimum, supported, newer_untested, declared_incompatible, unreadable (supported stays a fully silent pass, so the pass itself emits no JSON). The CodeRabbit thread at pm-github-closeout.yml:334 is fixed by making every remedy hold-aware: when pm-github-version selects the release, callers are told to remove or update that hold, or move the workflow pin after dropping it; the no-hold remedy keeps the workflow-pin wording. Fixing the whole class: both reusable workflows (byte-identical preflight shells), the shared failure reporter, the sync alert body, README, both caller templates and the recovery doc.

value.author: pi-pm-github-279-1126
value.text: Round 2 implementation complete. Outcome table now enforced in both reusable workflows (byte-identical preflight shells, verified by the publication suite): below_minimum stops, supported stays a fully silent pass (no JSON, no summary), newer_untested emits exactly one warning annotation plus one job-summary line, writes pm-cli-host-compatibility-hint and the host_compatibility step output, and continues; declared_incompatible stops only at or above the release's reviewed pmCliIncompatibleFrom metadata value (absent here; a declaration at or below the tested ceiling or an unstable value fails closed as an unreadable range); unreadable covers missing/failing/malformed launchers, prerelease hosts and unreadable/contradictory ranges. Every remedy is hold-aware (CodeRabbit thread on pm-github-closeout.yml:334): when pm-github-version selects the release, callers are told to remove or update that hold, or move the workflow pin after dropping it; hold-free callers keep the plain workflow-pin remedy. The shared failure reporter now leads any post-preflight failure message with the newer-host hint before the preserved underlying error, and the sync alert body leads with the same validated hint (regex-anchored, newline-free) before the failing step. The preflight JSON diagnostic carries case: below_minimum / supported / newer_untested / declared_incompatible / unreadable (supported emits no JSON at all by design; a silent pass is asserted byte-exact).

No existing test was weakened or deleted; every prior round-1 scenario retains a stricter assertion.

value.author: pi-pm-github-279-1126
value.text: Review round 3 (nine unresolved CodeRabbit threads on the round-2 head): all eight new findings verified valid and fixed; the first thread (explicit hold in the pin remedy) was already fixed in the round-2 commit b33de0d and verified at the head. Fixes: (1) both preflight probes now killSignal SIGKILL so a launcher that traps or ignores SIGTERM cannot hold the job past the 10s probe deadline; (2) a prerelease host gets its own remedy (install a stable pm CLI release within the tested range; retry wording when the range itself is unreadable) instead of the pin/hold wording that cannot fix it; (3) report_workflow_failure reads one line of the hint file and prints it only when it matches the preflight's exact fixed grammar (both remedy variants, canonical version slots, fully anchored), so a replaced file can never bypass the privacy gate in either the gated or gate-blocked branch; (4) the sync alert body validates the same full grammar, so poisoned step-output text with any suffix, padding or prerelease slot is refused; (5) package-metadata and the preflight test now share the preflights' canonical stable-version grammar, rejecting zero-padded components like 2026.11.023; (6) scenario fixtures always set REQUESTED_PM_GITHUB_VERSION (hold ?? empty) so inherited shell values cannot flip no-hold wording; (7) the fleet-pair test follows the release's recorded policy (floor, ceiling and pmCliIncompatibleFrom pass-through) so a pin advance or a new declared cutoff changes the assertion instead of breaking the fixture. The review's Linked-Issues pre-merge check (stop newer hosts) is refused with evidence: the issue author corrected that wording in the previous round and this round's instructions keep warn-and-continue; the real pair (pm CLI 2026.11.24 with this release's locked host 2026.11.22) is covered by the fleet-pair warning test.

value.author: pi-pm-github-279-1126
value.text: Round 3 revert proofs (disposable copy, original worktree untouched). Stage A - both workflows restored to the reviewed round-2 head: 10 focused tests fail exactly as the findings predict: 'launcher ignoring SIGTERM' for sync and closeout (the probe hangs to the outer timeout, 15.08s each, instead of being killed at 10s), the three prerelease-host scenarios for both workflows (old pin/hold wording), the apply-failure hint test (the old reporter prints replaced file content unvalidated) and the alert hint test (the old prefix-only pattern accepts suffixed/padded text). Stage B - only killSignal removed: exactly the two SIGTERM-trap scenarios fail. Stage C - only the metadata grammar loosened back to digit-dot form: exactly the canonical grammar test fails (padding accepted). No existing test was weakened or deleted; the round-2 scenario set keeps all its assertions and gained six scenarios and three poisoned-hint regression cases.
